repos.name: redhat-et/ripwire
repos.description: The ripgrep of AI context: a zero-dependency C++23 CLI + MCP server giving coding agents a ranked, deterministic map of any repo, blast radius, tests-to-run and quality deltas. Signatures at 80% fewer bytes than bodies; ~5% of a grep-and-read pass's tokens.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance C++23 CLI and MCP server providing a deterministic, ranked map of repository context for AI coding agents.
bullets: Built with C++23 for zero-dependency, high-speed repository indexing.
Implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to serve as a standardized interface for LLMs.
Generates ranked maps of codebases, including blast radius analysis and quality deltas.
Optimizes agentic workflows by reducing context noise by up to 80%.

repos.name: lightpanda-io/browser
repos.description: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation
repos.one_liner: A lightweight, headless browser engine written in Zig, specifically optimized for AI agents and automation tasks.
bullets: Engineered in Zig for extreme performance and minimal memory footprint compared to Chromium-based alternatives.
Designed specifically for headless automation, scraping, and agentic web interaction.
Provides a stable, predictable environment for LLMs to navigate complex web interfaces.
Ideal for fintech data extraction and automated market research workflows.

repos.name: mksglu/context-mode
repos.description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and   enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
repos.one_liner: A sophisticated context window optimization framework for AI coding agents that utilizes MCP to manage session memory and tool output.
bullets: Reduces LLM context consumption by up to 98% through intelligent tool output sandboxing.
Supports multi-platform routing across 17 different AI providers via MCP hooks.
Enforces persistent session memory to maintain state across long-running coding tasks.
Critical for complex financial modeling or large-scale codebase refactoring agents.

repos.name: heygen-com/hyperframes
repos.description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
repos.one_liner: A framework for rendering high-fidelity video directly from HTML/CSS, purpose-built for agentic video generation.
bullets: Uses TypeScript to bridge the gap between web-based UI design and video production.
Enables programmatic video generation, ideal for automated financial reporting or personalized client updates.
Designed for integration into agentic pipelines that require visual output.
Simplifies the creation of dynamic, data-driven video content without manual editing.

repos.name: coldteadotai/pr-lens
repos.description: PR Lens draws every PR as animated architecture and data-flow diagrams, inside the pull request itself. Use it as a GitHub App, GitHub Action, CLI, or a skill for your coding agent
repos.one_liner: A tool that visualizes pull requests as animated architecture and data-flow diagrams to improve code review efficiency.
bullets: Available as a GitHub App, Action, CLI, or an integrated skill for AI coding agents.
Automatically generates visual representations of data flow and architectural changes.
Enhances developer productivity by providing immediate visual context for complex PRs.
Useful for auditing financial software changes where architectural integrity is paramount.
